# existence entity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:existenceEntity`](gmeow-existenceEntity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/existenceEntity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lifecycle`](../../slices/lifecycle.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The entity whose existence is recorded by this [`EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md). Functional: an [`EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) concerns exactly one entity (constitutive of the situation's identity).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:existenceEntity`](gmeow-existenceEntity.md) from [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md), [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on an [`EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) to name the single entity whose existence-over-time the situation records.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at more than one entity (it is functional and identity-constitutive — mint a separate [`EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) per entity) and avoid using it on the flat form, which attaches existence directly to the entity.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:existenceEntity`](gmeow-existenceEntity.md) once from the [`EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) to its subject; the someValuesFrom axiom requires it and SHACL closes the exactly-one cardinality.

- ex:troyExistence [`gmeow:existenceEntity`](gmeow-existenceEntity.md) ex:troy.
